response.sql: WITH order_invoices AS (SELECT COUNT(i.invoice_number) as invoice_count FROM Orders o LEFT JOIN Invoices i ON o.order_id = i.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id), shares_data AS (SELECT invoice_count, CAST(invoice_count AS DECIMAL(19,4)) / SUM(invoice_count) OVER () as share FROM order_invoices), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM shares_data) SELECT SUM(invoice_count) as total_number_of_invoices, AVG(share) as average_share, AVG(share - (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share)) as average_excess_share FROM shares_data WHERE share > (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share)
